item.title: Dwayne Johnson Revealed as Maui in Moana Remake
item.description: Disney reveals Dwayne Johnson as Maui in the live-action Moana remake, with Catherine Laga’aia cast as Moana and original creators returning.

item.title: Uzor Arukwe Rejects Being Typecast in Igbo Roles
item.description: Uzor Arukwe says he refuses to be boxed into Igbo roles, highlighting his versatility at the premiere of EVI, a film exploring resilience in music and life.

item.title: Portable vs Carter Efe Face Off Ahead of Boxing Match
item.description: Portable and Carter Efe face off in Lagos ahead of their ₦150m celebrity boxing match, with Chaos in the Ring set for May 1, 2026 at Federal Palace Hotel.

item.title: Klopp Rejects Real Madrid Links, Hints at Future Return
item.description: Jürgen Klopp dismisses Real Madrid rumours as “nonsense” while leaving the door open for a future return to coaching as he focuses on his Red Bull role.

item.title: Community Shield Moves to Cardiff from Wembley
item.description: The 2026 Community Shield will be held in Cardiff due to Wembley scheduling clashes, marking its first return to the Principality Stadium since 2006.

item.title: Megan Thee Stallion Hospitalized After Theatre Incident
item.description: Megan Thee Stallion hospitalized after falling ill at a theatre show in New York. Fans send support as updates on her condition are awaited.

item.title: Taylor Swift Drops “Elizabeth Taylor” Music Video
item.description: Taylor Swift releases the “Elizabeth Taylor” music video, a tribute blending classic Hollywood clips with modern storytelling and vintage glamour.

item.title: Celebrities React to Jos Killings: Outrage or Relevance?
item.description: Nigerian celebrities react to the Jos massacre with grief and anger, sparking debate on whether their outrage reflects genuine concern or social relevance.

item.title: Tems Performs “What You Need” on Jimmy Fallon Show
item.description: Tems performs “What You Need” on The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon, reinforcing her global influence and continued rise on international stages.

item.title: Italy Miss Third Straight World Cup After Playoff Loss
item.description: Italy miss a third straight World Cup after playoff loss to Bosnia, extending a disappointing run for the four-time champions.

item.title: Sweden Qualify for 2026 World Cup After Win vs Poland
item.description: Sweden qualify for the 2026 World Cup after a dramatic 3-2 win over Poland, with Viktor Gyökeres scoring a late winner in the playoff clash.

item.title: Young Dolph Killer Sentencing Postponed Over Threats
item.description: Sentencing of Young Dolph’s killer Justin Johnson is postponed due to prison threats, delaying closure for the rapper’s family and fans.

item.title: Drake Sets Billboard 200 Record With 10 Charting Albums
item.description: Drake becomes the first hip hop artiste to chart 10 albums simultaneously on the Billboard 200, reinforcing his dominance in global music.

item.title: DR Congo Qualifies for World Cup After 52-Year Wait
item.description: DR Congo qualifies for the World Cup after 52 years, defeating Jamaica 1-0 in a dramatic playoff with Axel Tuanzebe scoring the extra-time winner.

item.title: Super Eagles Held to 2–2 Draw by Jordan in Friendly
item.description: Super Eagles draw 2–2 with Jordan in an international friendly, with goals from Moses Simon and Emmanuel Fernandez and a late red card.
